name: recipes
description: A recipe archive rendered from markdown fixtures into a single self-contained HTML file, or a static site.

scripts.test: npm run test:file && npm run test:web
scripts.test:file: node src/build.js && node test/verify.mjs && node test/interact.mjs
scripts.test:web: node src/build-web.js && node test/verify.mjs --web && node test/interact.mjs --web
